::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** April 13th1875  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Harvard University, Houghton Library
:::

Dear [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd)

I have stupidly lost [Mr Freeman](people/person_523.qmd)’s London address - would you be so kind as to send it to me on a card. I want to settle about divisions of chapters in the [French writing](cmy_books/cmybook_99.qmd).  Shall I finish all, and then abridge, or do you want to begin printing?[^1]

yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: In fact CMY was being sanguine in supposing that Freeman, the editor of the 'Historical Course for Schools' in which her *History of France* was to appear,  considered her book ready for the press.
